people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Cyprus
people.line: Island in the Mediterranean Sea; early Christian community

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
translations.bsb: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement),
translations.kjv: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
translations.asv: And Joseph, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of exhortation), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
